lighting_shading.note: Soft, diffuse lighting creates gentle volume without harsh shadows.

value_contrast.note: Warm wood tones pop clearly against the cool blue water.

color_palette.note: Vibrant orange boat contrasts strongly with the cyan water.

composition_hierarchy.note: Diagonal composition leads the eye from dock to boat.

shape_proportions.note: Chunky, toy-like proportions make the boat instantly readable.

viewpoint_depth.note: Three-quarter view shows both the boat interior and dock.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by color and shading, not line art.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, matte finish suggests painted wood or plastic toy.

rhythm_staging.note: Calm, static scene with gentle water ripples adding life.
